notes: has_largest_city(nigeria, milan) is the edit (inverse largest_city_of, a subproperty of located_in). Milan's stored place in Europe and its stored official language, Italian, are the side facts the edit forces out in every world (gives_up); 'Milan is in Italy' stays, so Milan is in both Italy and Nigeria (located_in is many-valued): q0 is not exclusive. The English rule is a class axiom over places in Nigeria. related[0]: the state or region of the largest city of Nigeria (has_largest_city then located_in): Lagos State before (lagos_state, firm), Lombardy after (milan_lombardy, firm, the bridge 'Milan is in Lombardy'), since the edit replaces Lagos by Milan as the largest city.

background.english_rule: located_in value nigeria ⊑ has_official_language value english
